question: Can an angularly smooth, reaction-bearing radial surface potential give a local held mouth a sideways load in the upstream converting brane?
model: Each spherical brane slice at fixed w has center C(w). The specific potential is scale*chi(w)*Morse(r0+(|x-Ce|−R(w))/0.01), with scale=2*shared_scale and r0 the cross-layer rest separation. This radial-in-slice separation is a hypothesis. The fourth-coordinate constraint acts only in w. Individual tag masses cancel from all normalized measurements. Static Eulerian injection at the inlet cut is uniform over solid angle, with no independent material-to-geometry transfer law derived. Warm feed means Gaussian spread in radial launch speed at the well minimum, not a thermal equilibrium population in position and velocity. No other species’ stress is included.
sign: External holder reaction integrated over the fixed region divided by tagged mass flow equals mean outgoing vx minus incoming vx. Material on well has the opposite sign. An H-shaped actuator instead reads integral H times the local holder traction. The incident-stream coefficient is (mean vx at entry minus mean vx at cut) divided by incident drift, after subtracting zero drift. All cuts precede open discharge.
observable_scope: Angular dipole is 3<cos(theta)> of crossing counts about the geometric section center. Proximity means location within the half-depth neighborhood of the unit-strength Morse well, regardless of local chi. The instant negative radial-energy diagnostic in the tangent run is a different quantity. The dynamical attachment fraction cannot be inferred from either proximity or undeformed current within a radial band. Near-wall carrier flux is an interpolated Q2 cross-section integral, subcell for the narrow bands.
refinement: Finite-interval velocity quadrature uses a Gaussian normalized on ±9 standard deviations. Gaussian integration by parts on that finite interval neglects a density-weighted endpoint term; it is used as a numerical estimator. Direct variational derivatives are primary. Twelve-node Hermite quadrature describes its discrete feed only. Fractions are incremental and cut dependent.
research_decision: Retain smooth normal contact as a conditional local transfer route at 0PN. The signed force in the bend is measured in this well, with independent finite/half, energy and tangent checks. Site flux, transmitting wall support, outgoing impulse at physical discharge and inertia under the same preparation remain independent inputs; physical held/push, release and universality are open.

reviews.scope: Independent Cartesian-to-tangent derivation and numeric checks on mesh 34
reviews.verdict: Clear for the signed net holder and bend-conjugate tagged-material reactions and the all-tag angular crossing dipole in the stated finite radial well, for the cold and 12-node thermal preparations on mesh 34. The large dipole is predominantly displacement relative to the shifted section center. These fixture readings do not determine the participating mass flux, physical wall force, or free acceleration.

reviews.scope: Signed bends, ideal guide, section flow and reaction routing
reviews.verdict: Scoped clear for the per-tagged-flux finite-well forces, curved and constant-radius ideal-guide comparisons, spherical crossing dipoles, and the reference-carrier current integrated over the stated inner radial bands. Opposite forces across the bend can nearly cancel while the holder that preserves its shape bears a substantial load. The physical mouth’s tagged throughput, reaction routing and free acceleration remain undetermined.

reviews.scope: Stationary incident-stream phase through the 512-node finite-interval comparisons
reviews.verdict: Scoped clear for a positive, cut-dependent transfer of incident sideways momentum to this stationary trial well, per unit tagged influx. Direct trajectories and radial sensitivity with angular-momentum conservation agree for matched preparations. The warm coefficient near shear order 0.01 is approximately 0.32 at the tested resolutions. A holding force on a physical mouth, the fraction of the intake that participates, and the fraction retained after discharge remain open.

reviews.scope: Final record, STATUS entry, and refined 1024/2048-point incident data
reviews.verdict: Scoped clear for the signed bend coefficients, the conditional incident-stream fractions at the stated cuts, the sampled geometric carrier current, and the decision to withhold physical free fall. The reported 32% applies to the specified tagged supply and smooth contact law through the measured cut.
